rules: Raw artifact committed under docs/trace/live/captures/<wave>/ with UTC timestamps + producing command
WIRED only when a raw artifact supports that specific hop; prose/source/test-summary alone does not qualify
S15-S19 stay MISSING and S-APPROVAL stays PENDING until raw capture exists
No paid provider call without explicit operator approval and a budget cap

entries.recipe: npx playwright test specs/replay-state.spec.ts --project=chrome --reporter=json with websocket tap persisted to docs/trace/live/captures/w4/S10-frames.jsonl
entries.acceptance: frame pair + inert replay DOM + banner/revision + screenshot + manifest sha256

artifacts: run id (and DB row if live)
entries.recipe: mocked-WS dist harness driving node events, or approved deterministic live run; persist to docs/trace/live/captures/w4/S15-19-frames.jsonl
entries.acceptance: one card per kind rendered from captured frames; state label from enum; screenshot+frames committed

entries.recipe: live or wiremock-driven run with WS tap + read-only DB row copy; persist to docs/trace/live/captures/w4/S27-frames.jsonl
entries.acceptance: delta order + terminal usage matches run row + rendered stream + no fake completion

artifacts: APPROVAL_RESOLVE command + ACK/APPROVAL_RESOLVED or ERROR frames
entries.recipe: mocked-WS dist harness sending APPROVAL_REQUEST and intercepting APPROVAL_RESOLVE; persist to docs/trace/live/captures/w4/S-APPROVAL-frames.jsonl
entries.acceptance: overlay + nonce handling + approve/deny command + ACK/named refusal + no silent effect

entries.recipe: dist harness or live server capture at current HEAD; persist to docs/trace/live/captures/w4/S22-frames.jsonl
entries.acceptance: raw roundtrip + rendered entries on current HEAD with sha256 manifest
